title: Pagadian sea patrol intercepts P2.3-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Four men were arrested and at least P2.3 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes were seized in a joint maritime law enforcement operation in Barangay White Beach here Wednesday morning. Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson for the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), said the four suspects are residents of Maguindanao del Norte, aged 20, 26, 30, and 32.
